value.signature: fn decode_block (bytes : & [u8] , limits : Limits) -> Result < Block , Refusal >

review.body: { let result = (| | { let mut reader = Reader :: new (bytes , limits) ? ; reader . header () ? ; let header_end = reader . pos ; let count = reader . entries () ? ; let transactions_start = reader . pos ; for _ in 0 .. count { reader . transaction () ? ; } if reader . pos != bytes . len () { return Err (Refusal :: Trailing) ; } let header : elements :: BlockHeader = elements :: encode :: deserialize (& bytes [.. header_end]) . map_err (| _ | Refusal :: Codec) ? ; drop (header) ; let mut cursor = transactions_start ; let mut transactions = Vec :: with_capacity (count) ; for _ in 0 .. count { let mut tx_reader = Reader :: new (& bytes [cursor ..] , limits) ? ; tx_reader . transaction () ? ; let tx = elements :: encoding :: decode_from_slice (& bytes [cursor .. cursor + tx_reader . pos]) . map_err (| _ | Refusal :: Codec) ? ; transactions . push (project (tx)) ; cursor += tx_reader . pos ; } Ok (Block { header : bytes [.. header_end] . to_vec () , transactions , }) }) () ; if result . is_err () { tracing :: info ! (outcome = "refusal") ; } result }
review.item_premise: The whole block is preflighted before allocation; every layout is retained, including transactions that cannot serve as explicit evidence.
